source: ECMWF open-data IFS 0.25-degree ENS perturbed member
unit_note: the surface record is geopotential in m2 s-2; the mapping converts to metres with the declared scale 1/9.80665
time_policy: decoded at every valid time and required invariant
member_policy: All primary messages are one member selected by JSON index and verified against the packaged member grammar. The deterministic oper control is a separate source.
licensing: ECMWF open data, CC BY 4.0, attribution required.
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
